@graph.name: 3 Day Ijen, Bromo & Madakaripura Waterfall Discovery from Surabaya

review.reviewBody: I took a solo 3 days-2 nights package to explore Mount Bromo and Kawah Ijen. From the pickup on Friday night at Surabaya airport to the drop off on the Sunday everything was perfect. I had a guide + a driver who made sure that I was always fine. Food, hotel, gas mask, explanation and mental support. It's all included. We even got to stop by hot springs which was something very pleasant after Ijen hiking. My guide knew all the best spots to take pictures, and avoid the crowd. The adventure itself is just breathtaking and I'm definitely advising anyone to use Sam's service for incredible memories! Thanks again!
